/**
 * PRIVATE full-publication source metadata port. No public HTTP route and no
 * initial upload witness change. The Node SDK finishes every page inside one
 * read-only repeatable-read transaction before returning complete:true.
 */
import type {
  SourcePrivacyPacket,
  SourceCustodyWitness,
} from "./current-custody-protocol.js";

export const HISTORY_CURRENT_METADATA_PROTOCOL = "history-current-metadata-v1";
export const HISTORY_CUSTODY_RECORD_IDS = 500;
export const HISTORY_CUSTODY_OWNER_PAGE = 8;
export const HISTORY_CUSTODY_ROWS = 10_000;
export const HISTORY_CUSTODY_PAGE_BYTES = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
export const HISTORY_CUSTODY_LOOKUP_BYTES = 64 * 1024 * 1024;

export interface HistoryCustodyProviderIdentity {
  protocol: "history-source-provider-v1";
  hostname: string;
  database: string;
  databaseOid: string;
  serverVersion: string;
  catalogSequenceOid: string;
  projectionSequenceOid: string;
}
export interface HistoryCustodyAuthority {
  sourceAuthoritySha256: string;
  /** Excludes caller role; Root binds this to the original provider/DB proof. */
  providerIdentitySha256: string;
  providerIdentity: HistoryCustodyProviderIdentity;
  /** Safe catalog/index/role facts only. Never a URL, password, or row payload. */
  descriptor: Record<string, unknown>;
}
export interface HistoryCustodyLookupInput {
  orgId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  recordIds: readonly string[];
  /** All raw-pointer and prior target owners, including owners with no live row. */
  priorOwners: readonly string[];
  expectedSourceAuthoritySha256: string;
  expectedProviderIdentitySha256: string;
  controlEpoch: string;
}
export interface HistoryCustodyRow {
  originId: string;
  recordId: string;
  userId: string;
  revision: string;
  revisionId: string;
  digest: string;
  kind: string;
  source: string;
  sessionId: string | null;
  operation: "upsert" | "delete";
  receivedAt: string;
  /** Independent nullable domains. Neither is a globally unique clock. */
  catalogAcceptedSeq: string | null;
  projectionAcceptedSeq: string | null;
  projectedExists: boolean;
  currentFenced: boolean;
}
export interface HistoryCustodyOwnerHead {
  userId: string;
  controlEpoch: string;
  version: string;
  pending: boolean;
  pendingControl: SourceCustodyWitness["pendingControl"];
  privacyVersion: string;
}
export interface HistoryCustodyOwner extends HistoryCustodyOwnerHead {
  /** Null never proves empty privacy; completed-version USER seals remain required. */
  privacy: SourcePrivacyPacket | null;
}
export interface HistoryCustodyTerminal {
  rowCount: number;
  ownerCount: number;
  recordPages: number;
  ownerPages: number;
  /** SHA256(previous hex + newline + native PostgreSQL JSONB page SHA256). */
  chainSha256: string;
}
export interface HistoryCustodySnapshot {
  protocol: typeof HISTORY_CURRENT_METADATA_PROTOCOL;
  orgId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  sourceAuthoritySha256: string;
  providerIdentitySha256: string;
  controlEpoch: string;
  complete: true;
  requestedRecordIds: string[];
  rows: HistoryCustodyRow[];
  owners: HistoryCustodyOwner[];
  terminal: HistoryCustodyTerminal;
  lookupSha256: string;
}
export interface HistoryCustodyRevalidateInput {
  orgId: string;
  workspaceId: string;
  expectedSourceAuthoritySha256: string;
  expectedProviderIdentitySha256: string;
  controlEpoch: string;
  /** The COMPLETE snapshot owner union, not just currently surviving row owners. */
  owners: readonly string[];
}
export interface HistoryCustodyRevalidation {
  protocol: typeof HISTORY_CURRENT_METADATA_PROTOCOL;
  sourceAuthoritySha256: string;
  providerIdentitySha256: string;
  controlEpoch: string;
  complete: true;
  owners: HistoryCustodyOwnerHead[];
  lookupSha256: string;
}
export interface HistoryCustodySourcePort {
  snapshot(
    input: HistoryCustodyLookupInput,
    signal?: AbortSignal,
  ): Promise<HistoryCustodySnapshot>;
  /** Fresh source statement snapshot after all metadata/S3 work, before target CAS. */
  revalidate(
    input: HistoryCustodyRevalidateInput,
    signal?: AbortSignal,
  ): Promise<HistoryCustodyRevalidation>;
}
